title: Kong launches Volcano, a cloud for AI agents and apps
summary: Volcano lets Kong sell infrastructure for running AI agents and web apps. Self-service pricing creates a path to usage revenue, and Konnect compatibility gives Kong a way to sell enterprise governance alongside hosting. Thesis decision is MAINTAIN at 69/100 pending evidence of paid adoption, revenue contribution and margins.
confirmed: Kong unveiled Volcano on September 30, 2026. The Volcano team introduced its sandbox on October 19, and Kong co-founder Marco Palladino published the cloud launch post on November 19. Volcano now offers self-service signup.

Volcano lists resumable workflows, isolated sandboxes, branchable PostgreSQL with vector support, Next.js hosting, authentication, storage and real-time services. Volcano describes LavaFlow as a tool that detects and fixes bugs in hosted apps and agents.

The published pricing includes a free Hobby plan, metered Superagent starting at $17 per month billed annually, and custom Enterprise pricing. Kong says Volcano can run on its own or alongside Konnect for enterprise governance.
uncertain: Volcano Services, LLC is named in the service terms. The launch materials reviewed do not quantify paid customer adoption, revenue, margins or how Volcano contributes to Kong’s consolidated results.

LavaFlow’s real-world reliability and Volcano’s competitive traction need customer evidence. The sources reviewed provide no new basis for changing Kong’s ARR or valuation inputs or projecting an IPO date.
